description: This file implements the HttpStreamFactory class responsible for managing HTTP stream requests, WebSocket handshakes, bidirectional streams, and preconnecting streams within the Chromium networking stack. It handles processing of alternative services, host rewriting, and manages JobController instances for stream operations.

classes.name: HttpStreamFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing HTTP streams, WebSocket handshakes, and preconnection jobs within Chromium's network stack.

methods.name: ProcessAlternativeServices
methods.description: Processes the 'Alt-Svc' header to set alternative services for a given server.

methods.name: RewriteHost
methods.description: Rewrites the host of a server URL based on host mapping rules.

methods.name: RequestStream
methods.description: Initiates a request for an HTTP stream.

methods.name: RequestWebSocketHandshakeStream
methods.description: Initiates a WebSocket handshake stream request.

methods.name: RequestBidirectionalStreamImpl
methods.description: Requests a bidirectional stream over HTTPS.

methods.name: RequestStreamInternal
methods.description: Internal method to handle stream request creation, managing job controllers.

methods.name: PreconnectStreams
methods.description: Preconnects a specified number of streams for a given request.

methods.name: GetHostMappingRules
methods.description: Retrieves host mapping rules for host rewriting.

methods.name: OnJobControllerComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when a JobController completes its task, cleaning up references.
